product_launches.description: Easebuzz launched Banking Connect IBMB (Interoperable Net & Mobile Banking) at GFF 2025 in Mumbai, built with NPCI Bharat BillPay. The platform standardizes NEFT/RTGS/IMPS, intent, QR and redirection flows with one-time setup, faster settlements, and centralized dispute management; demoed with NPCI and ICICI Prudential.

overview_description.description:
Easebuzz is a full-stack payment solutions platform that offers a comprehensive suite of API-driven financial services designed to help businesses digitize payments and manage end-to-end financial operations. These services include digital payment collections, payment disbursals, connected banking, split payments, automated reconciliation, vendor payments, sub-merchant management, and refund management. 

Easebuzz serves a diverse clientele across various sectors such as education, retail, non-banking financial companies (NBFCs), insurance, e-commerce, direct-to-consumer (D2C), travel, and tourism. The platform supports multiple payment modes, including credit cards, debit cards, net banking, UPI, EMI, buy now pay later (BNPL), and wallets, facilitating seamless transactions for businesses and their customers.

about_short_description.short_description: Easebuzz is a payment solutions platform that offers a suite of API-driven financial services to help businesses digitize payments.

product.name: Payment Gateway
product.description: An API-based online payment acceptance service supporting cards, UPI, net banking, wallets, EMI, BNPL, bank transfers, and recurring payment mandates.

product.name: Payment Links
product.description: A no-code payment collection service for creating and sharing hosted checkout links through WhatsApp, SMS, email, social media, or QR codes.

product.name: Easebuzz Neo
product.description: Connected banking APIs and a dashboard for managing business collections, payouts, refunds, expenses, and financial reporting.

product.name: Slices
product.description: A split-payment and settlement service that allocates incoming payments across multiple vendors, sellers, partners, or bank accounts.

product.name: InstaCollect
product.description: A virtual-account and virtual-UPI collection service for receiving payments through UPI, IMPS, NEFT, and RTGS with automated reconciliation.

product.name: Wire Payouts
product.description: A business disbursement service for sending vendor payments, refunds, employee payments, and other transfers through NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, and UPI.
